documents.population: International students (not citizens of Australia or New Zealand or permanent residents of Australia) applying to UTS undergraduate courses, including the Bachelor of Computing Science
documents.notes: UTS 'International Student Undergraduate Application Form' (PDF, form 400_032, footer 'SEPTEMBER 2026', a form version, not a cycle), section 16 'Checklist'. The checklist's two columns are interleaved in the PDF text; each item quotes its own checklist line. UTS accepts only copies certified by employees of specific organisations. Not drafted: proof of payment of the A$100 application fee; certified copy of RPL details, copy of visa, details of exclusions, medical statement (each 'if applicable'). The UTS web pages guessed in round 2 answered 404; this form is on www.uts.edu.au.

items.quote: 16. CHECKLIST Have you: Completed all sections of this application?
Attached a certified copy of your passport?
Attached details of English language proficiency?
items.notes: Section 5: if the applicant has taken an English test (e.g. IELTS, TOEFL, PTE), 'please attach a certified copy of your results'.

items.quote: Attached a certified copy of qualifications including academic transcripts?
Attached a certified official translation of any document not in English?
Attached copies of letter of guarantee documents from your sponsor? (if applicable)
items.condition: sponsored applicants (letter of guarantee from the sponsor), if applicable

items.quote: Attached a supporting statement and/or portfolio? (if applicable)
items.condition: if applicable (courses that require a supporting statement and/or portfolio)
